private_bridge.meaning: The public CI validates the commitment/index graph, not the underlying private text, image, prompt, attachment, or conversation bytes.

origin/event ordering without requiring raw content
provider-visible provenance evidence and its limits
image/audio/text technical features; heuristic unless provider-verified
typed navigation edges between opaque nodes
evidence strength is separate from semantic similarity

public_observations.observation: Supported images generated with ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API include C2PA Content Credentials and SynthID provenance signals.
The public OpenAI verification tool currently checks supported image and audio files for OpenAI-associated provenance signals.
The public verification surface described above does not provide an equivalent supported provenance-verification claim for text.
C2PA metadata can be stripped or lost and watermark signals can degrade; absence of a supported signal is not proof of non-origin.
